name: Alchemist Living Siphon
body:
Some alchemists discover ways to change their bodies other than with a mutagen. Fewer still learn to forge their bodies into wells of magic that not only provide power for their own extracts but also allow them to draw in power from others, heightening their skills in magic beyond other alchemists and bending magic to their will. These alchemists are Living Siphons and they excel in disrupting enemies that believe magic alone is enough to win any fight.

Living Siphon (Su)

At 1st level, the living siphon gains steal magic and pilfering payload.

This ability replaces mutagen.

Siphon Bauble (Su)

At 2nd level, the living siphon gains siphon bauble as the expertise of the same name except that the living siphon may expend an extract (emptying the vial) rather than a prepared spell slot.

This ability replaces poison use and poison resistance +2.

Spelljack Expertise (Su)

A living siphon may select one of the following spelljack expertise in place of an alchemist discovery: interference, perfect potion, pierce resistance, and rend magical protection.

Detect Magic (Sp)

At 5th level, a living siphon gains the ability to cast detect magic as a spell-like ability at will with a caster level equal to their class level. Additionally, this ability allows the living siphon to detect if a creature within the spell’s area has spells prepared, spell slots remaining or uses of spell-like abilities remaining.

This ability replaces poison resistance +4 and swift poisoning.

Pilfered Potency (Su)

Beginning at 8th level, whenever a creature within 30ft of the alchemist is the target of a harmless spell or spell-like ability (even those generated by spell trigger and spell completion magic items) the alchemist may attempt a caster level check (using their alchemist level as their caster level) as an immediate action, with a DC equal to 11+ the creature’s HD, if successful the alchemist receives the effect rather than the intended target. The alchemist may expend a charge of stolen magic to extend the range of pilfered potency to 60 feet.

This ability replaces poison resistance +6.

Cross Contamination (Su)

At 10th level, a living siphon learns to turn stolen magic into alchemical quintessence. By spending a charge of stolen magic the living siphon may prepare an expended extract as a swift action. This requires the expended charge of stolen magic to be of an equal or greater level than the extract to be prepared.

This ability replaces poison immunity.

Arcane Sight (Sp)

At 14th level, the living siphon may cast arcane sight at will rather than detect magic.

This ability replaces persistent mutagen.
